description:
Hybrid planning application (part full/part outline) for redevelopment of the site to provide a data centre comprising a data hall building, generator building, substation, internal roads and circulation routes, landscaping, boundary treatments, vehicular access, and associated infrastructure; and erection of a 3 storey building providing a community room, training facility and workspaces.

Full planning permission is sought for redevelopment of the site to provide a 12,869 sqm (GIA) data centre (Class B8) comprising a data hall building (31.5m in height), generator building (31m in height), substation, internal roads and circulation routes, landscaping, boundary treatments, vehicular access, and associated infrastructure.

Outline planning permission (with all matters reserved) is sought for the erection of a 3 storey building with a maximum floorspace of 810 sqm (GIA) providing a community room and training facility (Class F), and workspaces (Class E(g)).
